scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,storage,auth --project demo-app
scripts.emulators:all: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-app
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions run build && cross-env TEREMU_TEST_MOCKS=1 firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,storage,auth --project demo-app "npm --prefix functions run test"
